notes: Mid-market analytics SaaS (B2B product teams). Started with Hosted API to validate models for chat + semantic search. Now moving to Dedicated for production latency and data isolation. Needs: p95 chat latency <250ms for short-turn queries; embedding throughput 200 qps, cost sensitivity moderate — wants clear unit economics. Model preference: open models with Redwood-verified performance; will test a quantized 8-bit variant for cost vs FP16 baseline. Routing/fallback: initial canary (10% traffic) to Dedicated pool; automatic fallback to Hosted API in same region on capacity or latency breach; secondary failover to EU region for DR. Rollback policy: automatic rollback to Hosted if quality regression >5% on eval set or latency increase >30% for 3 consecutive minutes. Security: SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS integration, 1-year retention for logs, EU data residency for some customers. Quotes from call: "We need predictable tail latency before we flip to prod"; "Can we do a canary with consistent user routing?". POC acceptance criteria listed: 1) canary stability for 7 days; 2) no regression >3% on NPS-style prompt evals; 3) SLOs met for p95 latency. Pricing: interested in committed pool with burst capacity; finance requested a sample SOW. Next: finalize SOW and network prep (CIDR + firewall rules).
technical_summary: POC scope: Dedicated reserved pool sized for 12k tokens/min average, autoscale burst to 20k. Canary rollout: 10% traffic users mapped by user-id hash -> Dedicated. Fallback routing: on Pod saturation or p95 breach, route to Hosted API (same model family) — fallback latency budget 500ms. Model variants: baseline -> fp16 open model, cost variant -> 8-bit quantized variant. Region failover: primary us-east-1, secondary eu-west-1 (for EU customers). Rollback triggers: accuracy drop on eval set OR sustained latency degradation. Observability: token-level cost + tracing to be instrumented via Redwood Console.
sales_play_notes: Close path: finish 2-week Dedicated POC, deliver SLO report, present SOW for 12-month reserved commit. Upsell: Redwood Optimize for batching/caching suggestions. Blockers: budget sign-off, SOC2 certification timeline (client wants roadmap), infra needs VPC peering info.
